name: 3dgs-mcp-renderer-server
description: Agent-controlled 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering pipeline as an MCP server. Lets an LLM import .ply/.splat scenes, set cameras, modify Gaussians (position/opacity/scale/rotation/SH), render frames, ray-cast, prune by importance, sculpt scenes, encode/edit/transfer scene latents (SLAT), and export scene code — all through 21 MCP tools over stdio. Bundled with a three.js/WebGPU renderer served on localhost.
short_description: MCP server for agent-driven 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering — 21 tools over stdio.

npm.note: Publish mcp-server/ to npm as 3dgs-mcp-server for one-line install. Until then, clone and run from source (see stdio below).

stdio_source.note: Run from a clone. Build with `npm run build -w mcp-server` and use args ["/path/to/mcp-server/dist/index.js"] for the compiled version (no tsx needed).

tools.name: import_scene
tools.description: Import a .ply or .splat scene file from a whitelisted scene root into the live scene state.

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Set the active camera (position, target/lookAt, fov, near, far).

tools.name: modify_gaussians
tools.description: Modify Gaussian attributes (position, scale, rotation, opacity, SH color) by selector.

tools.name: render_frame
tools.description: Render the current scene to a frame and return the rendered image/preview.

tools.name: query_scene
tools.description: Query current scene state (Gaussian count, bounds, camera, density).

tools.name: cast_ray
tools.description: Cast a ray into the scene and return the hit Gaussian / point.

tools.name: export_result
tools.description: Export the current scene to .ply or .splat.

tools.name: prune_by_importance
tools.description: Prune Gaussians below an importance threshold.

tools.name: set_gaussian_density
tools.description: Adjust Gaussian density / splat scale.

tools.name: adjust_opacity
tools.description: Adjust Gaussian opacity by selector.

tools.name: set_rotation
tools.description: Set rotation of selected Gaussians.

tools.name: query_spatial_context
tools.description: Query spatial context around a point or region.

tools.name: resolve_voice_command
tools.description: Map a natural-language/voice command to a scene operation.

tools.name: define_scene_spec
tools.description: Define a declarative scene specification (SceneSpec).

tools.name: sculpt_pipeline
tools.description: Run the sculpt pipeline over a SceneSpec to build a scene.

tools.name: export_scene_code
tools.description: Export the scene as runnable scene-construction code.

tools.name: encode_scene_slatent
tools.description: Encode a scene into a SLAT (scene latent) representation.

tools.name: edit_scene_latent
tools.description: Apply a latent edit op to a SLAT and decode back to scene.

tools.name: list_slatents
tools.description: List stored scene latents (SLATs).

tools.name: transfer_scene_edit
tools.description: Transfer an edit from one scene's SLAT to another.

tools.name: interpolate_scene_latent
tools.description: Interpolate between two scene latents.
